key.name: monitor-configs
key.description: JSON object keyed by physical monitor identity. Each value is {"file": absolute path, "fitMode": "fill"|"fit"|"stretch"|null, "optimize": bool|null}. null uses the global default.

key.name: default-fit-mode
key.description: How video is scaled when a monitor has no fit-mode override.

key.name: startup-delay-ms
key.description: Milliseconds to wait after startup-complete before spawning players.

key.name: stagger-ms
key.description: Milliseconds between starting each logical monitor's player.

key.name: pause-on-maximized
key.description: Pause a monitor's player while a maximized or fullscreen window covers it.

key.name: pause-on-overview
key.description: Pause players while the Overview is visible.

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.description: Pause players while running on battery power.

key.name: optimize-videos
key.description: Prepare videos as target-sized SDR H.264 in preferences. Animated GIFs are always prepared. Login never transcodes.

key.name: video-output
key.description: mpv video output. auto is chosen from Milestone 1 measurements.

key.name: max-retries
key.description: Player restart limit before staying on the still.

key.name: wallpaper-applied
key.description: Whether the original wallpaper is saved and currently replaced.
